real.Milestone: M3.1, no symbols. With the oracle's own 18 symbols supplied it is 0.9970/0.8579; ./build.sh Fidelity reports both. The ratchet is the without-symbols number because that is what `skala format` does with no project.

constructs.Milestone: M9, re-based a second time: the xmldoc sub-formatter added two fixtures to constructs/trivia/, taking the set from 323 files to 324. ⚠ One of them diverges by a single line and it is NOT a regression — verified on the xmldoc branch in isolation, which produces the same output, and the source itself has no blank line there. The oracle INSERTS a blank line between a file's leading comment block and the first type declaration; Skala preserves the source. That is SK-DIV-0015, pre-existing and newly exposed rather than introduced. The previous population's numbers are the entry above this one in git history: 323 files at 0.9747/0.9257.
